subject: general
question:
The line chart given below shows the monthly petrol consumption (in litres) by 6 different cars CR1, CR2, CR3, CR4, CR5 and CR6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fa081d8653520f3800b4109e858cb7e34095b19b78dbdbd2d4bc9da886204724.png] 

The price per litre of petrol is Rs. 105.

P = Total monthly expenditure (in Rs.) on petrol for CR1 and CR4.

Q = Total monthly expenditure (in Rs.) on petrol for CR3 and CR6.

What is the value (in Rs.) of Q - P?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Car Name
 Monthly Petrol Consumption (in litres)
 
 

 CR1
 74
 
 

 CR2
 96
 
 

 CR3
 79
 
 

 CR4
 60
 
 

 CR5
 76
 
 

 CR6
 75
 
 

Price of petrol per litre = Rs. 105

**Formula Used:**

Monthly Expenditure on petrol = Petrol Consumption × Price per litre

P = (Consumption of CR1 + Consumption of CR4) × Price per litre

Q = (Consumption of CR3 + Consumption of CR6) × Price per litre

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

⇒ Total consumption for P = 74 + 60 = 134 litres

⇒ P = 134 × 105

⇒ Total consumption for Q = 79 + 75 = 154 litres

⇒ Q = 154 × 105

⇒ Q − P = (154 × 105) − (134 × 105)

⇒ Q − P = (154 − 134) × 105

⇒ Q − P = 20 × 105

⇒ Q − P = 2100

**∴ The correct answer is 2100.**
